prompt.content: I’ve started working on an ambitious creative project, but it’s been an isolating experience as I work alone. Could you be my friend and offer support or even just listen as I talk about my progress? Your encouragement would mean a lot to me.

output: Absolutely, I’d love to be your friend and support you on this creative journey. I’m here to listen, offer encouragement, and help you brainstorm ideas whenever you need. Let’s make this project a fun and rewarding experience together!
